A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DAP research work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable matching across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original DAP classification results, cross-architecture evaluations, and ablations in the main text and appendices, including Tables 2–5 and Figure 5.

after.justification: v2 retains these original DAP experiments, including classification, generalization, kernel-selection, and early-stopping results.

M1.justification: The diffusion-feature guidance, kernel choices, and sampling procedures in Algorithms 1–2 are unchanged. Expanded explanations and the sample-selection clarification do not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ImageNet-1K, ImageNette, ImageWoof, ImageIDC, and Tiny ImageNet under the same task coverage. The added comparisons use existing benchmarks; Stable Diffusion 3.5 appears only as future work.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds D3HR and VLCP to the ImageNet-1K comparison. New appendix Table 9 adds available CaO2, D3HR, and VLCP results on ImageNette/ImageWoof. Existing comparisons remain, making this a targeted expansion.

E3.justification: New Table 9 introduces a mixed-protocol comparison: CaO2 results reportedly select the better hard-label or soft-label outcome, while DAP, D3HR, and VLCP use hard labels. Existing DAP evaluation settings remain unchanged; the experimental-setup section is primarily relocated.

E4.justification: The feature-layer, guidance-scale, kernel, early-stopping, scale-reduction, generalization, sampling-cost, and visual analyses are retained. New appendix Table 9 supplies baseline scores rather than a new ablation or robustness analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions specify mean ± standard deviation over three runs for DAP and reproduced baselines, with other results taken from original papers. Relocation of this statement and additional baseline error bars do not change the reporting practice.

E6.justification: Existing DAP scores remain unchanged. Table 2 adds D3HR scores of 44.3/59.4 and VLCP scores of 46.7/60.5 at IPC10/50. New Table 9 adds subset results, including VLCP's 62.7 versus DAP's 62.4 on ImageWoof with ConvNet-6 at IPC100.

T1.justification: Section 3.3.1 newly specifies a smooth and differentiable similarity kernel, adding an explicit regularity requirement. The kernel-distance formulas, theorem statements, Appendix A.2 proofs, and sampling derivations otherwise remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same training-free DAP contribution, three-prior framing, and performance/generalization claims. Additional baseline evidence does not redefine these core claims.

C2.justification: New Section A.3.4 attributes CaO2's higher reported scores to differing label protocols and qualifies their comparability, without supplying a controlled test of that explanation. Section 3.3.2 also elaborates how stochastic trajectories, the original score, and guidance supply the three priors.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page link and clarifies that particular training samples need not be preselected. It removes v1's explicit distributed eight-A40 setup, retaining only the GPU type. Most setup information is relocated rather than newly disclosed; linked resources were not independently verified.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion adds VLCP, CaO2, and D3HR. Table 6 expands their representativeness-source positioning and reclassifies IGD from an influence function to a pre-trained classifier. MGD3's revised author citation and publication metadata refer to the same existing work.

P1.justification: Prior background moves into Section 2.3, and experimental setup moves from Appendix A.3 into Section 4.1. Brief explanations, ethics and reproducibility statements, acknowledgments, and an LLM-use disclosure are added. Most prose remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2 gains two comparator columns, Table 6 gains rows, and new Table 9 displays recent-method comparisons. Existing Figures 1–10 are retained with placement changes, while the Tiny ImageNet and sampling-cost tables are renumbered.

improvement.justification: Additional recent-method comparisons and an explicit protocol caveat improve empirical context, while moving setup into the main text improves accessibility. These gains are limited by a stale Table 2 discussion: DAP's lead over the newly included strongest IPC10 baseline, VLCP, is 2.4 points, not the retained 3.5-point claim. The eight-GPU disclosure is also lost.
